target_customer: Freight forwarders, professional couriers and shippers of time-critical items in healthcare and manufacturing
problem: Same-day, white glove shipments are coordinated by phone and spreadsheets. chrt provides dispatch, courier apps, booking and end-to-end tracking, including physical tracker devices.
business_model: B2B SaaS TMS for forwarders and couriers plus hardware tracker sales

founders.name: Kyle Reagan
prior_employers: A Series C time-critical logistics startup (unnamed), led strategy
education: Mechanical Engineering and Mathematics (school not named)
founders.background_notes: YC page: helped scale prior company 4x and worked with enterprise customers including J&J and Boeing.

founders.name: Aaron Carver
prior_employers: A YC company (unnamed), full stack developer
education: Chemical Engineering and Computational Science (school not named)

competitors.name: Airspace Technologies
competitors.what: Digital time-critical logistics forwarder and platform
competitors.funding_then: 70M USD round led by DBL Partners (May 2022)

technical_complexity.rationale: Dispatch software, mobile driver apps, flight booking integrations and IoT tracker hardware are standard but broad engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Operational workflow integration with couriers and forwarders plus hardware raises switching costs; domain expertise helps, but CXT and Dispatch Science already served dispatch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent dispatch vendors continued to serve couriers; no acquisition or copying of chrt found as of 2026.

market_need_then: Founders cite a 30B USD time-critical logistics market growing about 20% per year, driven by healthcare and manufacturing (company claim).

outcome_analysis: chrt is an Active Spring 2025 company led by founders with prior time-critical logistics and consulting experience, selling software and trackers to a niche market. Funding is unconfirmed beyond aggregator entries and no negative events are found, so its outcome is still open.
